sleeper.note: diagnostic: documents Finding A (directive signal 0 on extracted memory, activation-shape covers only cached poisons) on a clean hold-out; detection of these attacks comes from the provenance configs, not this guard.

activation_anomaly.note: embedding-anomaly signal (the attack's own off-cluster objective); catches planted memories incl. dormant sleepers that the dedicated guard (Finding A) cannot, but is NOT sleeper-specific (flags planted content generally) and costs ~10% benign FPR -- a review-queue posture. Provenance remains the primary sleeper defense.

union_defense.note: generalized defense (U-1). union2 = B13 OR cluster-outlier anomaly (99th pct, unsupervised). union3 also OR a supervised detector trained on DEV (transfer test). FPR on eval-half benign; review-queue posture.
